title: The Boring 2% Card Is the Right First Card
caption:
Your first rewards card doesn’t need to be exciting.

The best setup is one you’ll actually use consistently. Start by deciding whether you want straightforward cash back or travel points—and whether you want to learn how redemptions work.

You don’t need a five-card strategy on day one. Add complexity only when your existing spending gives you a clear reason, not because a bonus category looks impressive.

And don’t buy something just to earn rewards. Spending less can beat optimizing the card.

Which matters more to you: simple cash back or travel rewards?
